name: leadgreen
description: GPU energy per million output tokens by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon by country.
long_description: Lead Green is a public index of the GPU energy it takes to serve a million output tokens (watt-hours per million output tokens), by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon intensity to price it anywhere, published as open data with a JSON API and this MCP server under CC BY 4.0. Every figure comes from a named public source with a retrieval date; every answer names its source and carries the caveat that the figures are GPU-only floors measured on a busy server. The server reads the live API first and falls back to the snapshot bundled in the package, so it also works offline. It is a Katonic project, run and paid for by Katonic, and takes no money from hardware, cloud or model vendors. This bundle launches the published package with uv (`uvx leadgreen-mcp==0.3.1`, the same wheel https://leadgreen.ai/dist/ serves, with PyPI provenance), so it carries no vendored code and needs uv on the machine: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/.
